name: JW Marriott Marquis Hotel Dubai
positioning: Two-tower hotel in Business Bay beside the Dubai Water Canal, with skyline-view rooms, duplex penthouses on the top floors, a caravanserai-inspired spa and an outdoor pool with a swim-up bar
best_for: Travelers who want a Business Bay base near Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa and DIFC
Wellness-minded guests who want a hammam spa, a reformer studio and a health club in one hotel

facts.text: The hotel is in the Business Bay district along the Dubai Water Canal.
The hotel comprises two towers beside the Dubai Water Canal.
The hotel is near Dubai Metro, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, DIFC and Sheikh Zayed Road.
Rooms and family suites have skyline views, deluxe bedding and marble bathrooms.
Deluxe guest rooms have separate shower and bath facilities.
Saray Spa has private hammam rooms, spa suites and separate men's and women's spa lounges.
Club Marquis is the hotel's health club, and access is free for all hotel guests.
The Executive Lounge is on the 37th floor of Tower B.
Garden by Kitchen6 presents cuisines from around the world across six interactive live-cooking stations.
The Vault bar offers live entertainment and city views.
Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

highlights.text: The duplex penthouses are on the top floors of both towers, with a separate living area, master and guest bedrooms, a dining area, views of the Arabian Gulf and Executive Lounge access.
Saray Spa draws inspiration from the historic caravanserais along the old silk trade routes.
The outdoor pool has a swim-up bar, a children's pool and a plunge pool.
BodyBase is a boutique reformer studio at the hotel offering BaseGym and BaseFlow classes.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the large-scale property may feel less intimate.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
